description: Validator for the Record Call callflow action

action.description: Whether to start or stop the recording

format.description: What format to store the recording on disk

label.description: Label to include in the origin of call recording

media_id.description: Doc ID of the created recording - if unspecified, KAZOO will generate one

method.description: HTTP verb to use when sending the recording to the supplied URL

origin.description: How the recording was started - read-only

record_min_sec.description: The minimum length, in seconds, the recording must be to be considered successful. Otherwise it is deleted

record_on_answer.description: Whether to delay the recording until the channel is answered

record_on_bridge.description: Whether to delay the recording until the channel is bridged

record_sample_rate.description: What sampling rate to use on the recording

should_follow_transfer.description: If true, the recording will continue after a transfer on the active leg

silence_detection.description: Stop the recording when the caller goes quiet, as the other silence settings direct

silence_final_timeout.description: With silence_detection: milliseconds of silence, once sound has been heard, after which the recording stops (FreeSWITCH's RECORD_FINAL_TIMEOUT_MS)

silence_initial_timeout.description: With silence_detection: milliseconds to wait for the first sound before the recording stops; 0 waits indefinitely (FreeSWITCH's RECORD_INITIAL_TIMEOUT_MS)

silence_threshold.description: With silence_detection: the energy level below which audio counts as silence (FreeSWITCH's RECORD_SILENCE_THRESHOLD)

skip_module.description: When set to true this callflow action is skipped, advancing to the wildcard branch (if any)

time_limit.description: Time limit, in seconds, for the recording

url.description: The URL to use when sending the recording for storage
